Title: AKU Champions Paediatric Care with Tee Off for Kids
NewsSummary: Annual Golf Tournament expands access to life-saving care for children in need at AKUH
NewsContent:
The Aga Khan University (AKU) hosted its 8th annual Tee Off for Kids Golf Tournament at the Karachi Golf Club, uniting corporate leaders, philanthropists, and golf enthusiasts to support life-saving treatment for children in need at the Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH) in Karachi. 

Since 2016, when the tournament first brought corporate donors together to support the Mending Kids’ Hearts campaign for congenital heart disease, donor generosity has helped perform hundreds of life-saving cardiac procedures each year—providing vital financial assistance to over 70% of young patients from low-income families.

Building on this generosity, the scope of this year’s tournament expanded to support a wider range of critical paediatric treatments, including cancer care, treatment for heart diseases, cochlear implants, therapies for children with special needs. The goal remains clear: to ease the burden on families facing overwhelming challenges and give children the chance to grow, thrive and pursue the futures they deserve.

Siddiq Sons claimed the championship title at this year’s golf tournament, proudly lifting the coveted winners’ trophy after a standout performance. 

As a leader in paediatric health care, AKUH remains deeply committed to ensuring that every child, regardless of circumstance, has access to quality treatment and hope for a healthier future. Children continue to be the major beneficiaries of AKUH’s patient welfare programme, which provides access to quality care for patients from low-income backgrounds. From January to October 2025, over PKR 600 million was disbursed for inpatient paediatric care across AKUH and its outreach hospitals, with children making up 33% of all inpatient beneficiaries.
